# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Phase One: Boundless Brainstorm

> The Awtsmoos renews each frame and each line,
> on Awtsmoos.com may every hidden module align.

## Possible Root Causes

- CompactJS may reorder modules so readiness listeners run after readiness events.
- CompactJS may rewrite `import()` URLs relative to the generated bundle instead of the source module.
- Source may embed cache-busting hashes as path segments rather than query parameters.
- The canonical Chossid path may differ between local disk, public routing, and generated manifests.
- Required systems may initialize but fail to register their capabilities.
- One early exception may prevent all downstream readiness publication.
- The minimal meadow gate may require systems intentionally excluded from compact mode.
- The generated bundle may contain stale source from an earlier experiment tree.
- Asset copying may omit GLB files or preserve a symlink invalid in production.
- Dynamic imports may be impossible after flattening unless explicitly mapped.
- CompactJS may not preserve `import.meta.url`, base URLs, or module-scoped relative paths.
- Optional chat failure may be harmless alone but reveal a general dynamic-import defect.
- Browser cache or service-worker state may serve an obsolete bundle.
- The server may route extensionless paths differently from static asset paths.
- Public deployment may not match the inspected checkout.

## Ideal Repair Universe

1. A deterministic build emits a manifest of every source module and rewritten URL.
2. Dynamic imports resolve through a stable project-base resolver.
3. Assets resolve through one canonical URL service shared by source and compact modes.
4. Readiness becomes observable as structured state rather than timing-sensitive events.
5. Each subsystem publishes success or a precise failure cause.
6. CompactJS validates imported files and assets before emitting output.
7. Build tests execute generated code in a browser-equivalent harness.
8. A smoke page verifies movement, combat, inventory, quest, recovery, and streaming.
9. Generated artifacts include source hashes and build provenance.
10. The public deployment endpoint exposes the same tested artifact.

## Guardrails

- Do not suppress `MINIMAL_MEADOW_NOT_PLAYABLE`.
- Do not replace the Chossid with a fallback merely to hide the 404.
- Do not disable chat imports without tracing their URL construction.
- Do not hand-edit the compact bundle if a source or builder repair can regenerate it.
- Do not overwrite unrelated local changes.
